entries.content_osis: <div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" sID="pv6821"/><div sID="gen10477" type="x-p"/><div type="x-milestone" subType="x-preverse" eID="pv6821"/>5-9. Generosity, sound judgment in business, and confidence in God, form a character which preserves from fear of evil and ensures success against enemies.
